knowledge_base.text: To reset your Acme account password, go to Settings > Security > Reset Password and follow the emailed link. The link expires after 30 minutes.
VPN error 691 indicates an authentication failure. Confirm your username and password are correct and that your account is not locked before contacting IT.
Employees may expense client dinners up to $75 per person with an itemized receipt and the client's name and company noted on the expense report.
2019 PTO Policy: Full-time employees accrue 15 days of paid time off per year, credited monthly.
2024 PTO Policy Addendum (supersedes the 2019 policy): Full-time employees now receive unlimited PTO, subject to manager approval and a minimum of 10 days taken per year.
The remote work stipend of $50/month for home internet does not apply to employees on the Contractor or Intern employment tracks.
Benefits enrollment opens each year in the first two weeks of November. Changes take effect on January 1st of the following year.
If your office printer shows an offline error, check that it is connected to the 'Acme-Print' network and restart the print spooler service.
Guests can connect to the 'Acme-Guest' wifi network using the daily password posted at the front desk; it does not require a company account.
Expense report code EXP-114 is used for software subscription reimbursements under $50/month that do not require manager pre-approval.
Security incidents, including suspected phishing emails or lost devices, must be reported to security@acme.example within 1 hour of discovery.
Customer data is retained for 7 years after account closure to meet financial audit requirements, then permanently deleted.
Parental leave provides 16 weeks of fully paid leave for the primary caregiver and 6 weeks for the secondary caregiver, available to all full-time employees.
Employee referral bonuses are $2,000 for standard roles and $4,000 for senior engineering roles, paid out after the new hire completes 90 days.
Company laptops are eligible for replacement every 3 years, or sooner if hardware fails and cannot be repaired by IT within 5 business days.
Home office equipment reimbursement covers up to $300 one time for a monitor, chair, or keyboard, submitted through expense code EXP-220.
Slow application performance is often caused by too many browser tabs or an outdated client version; check for updates under Help > About.
The office building requires badge access after 7pm on weekdays and at all times on weekends; lost badges should be reported to facilities immediately.

golden_dataset.question: How do I reset my Acme account password?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: Go to Settings > Security > Reset Password and use the emailed link within 30 minutes.

golden_dataset.question: I'm getting VPN error 691, what does that mean?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: It's an authentication failure; verify your username/password and that your account isn't locked.

golden_dataset.question: Can I expense a client dinner and how much is covered?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: Yes, up to $75 per person with an itemized receipt and the client's name and company noted.

golden_dataset.question: How many PTO days do full-time employees get per year?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: Unlimited PTO as of the 2024 policy, subject to manager approval and a 10-day minimum taken per year (this supersedes the old 2019 15-day accrual policy).

golden_dataset.question: Does the remote work stipend apply to interns?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: No, the $50/month stipend does not apply to Contractor or Intern employment tracks.

golden_dataset.question: When does benefits enrollment open?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: The first two weeks of November each year, with changes effective January 1st.

golden_dataset.question: My office printer says it's offline, what should I check?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: Check it's connected to the Acme-Print network and restart the print spooler service.

golden_dataset.question: How do guests connect to wifi in the office?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: Guests use the Acme-Guest network with the daily password posted at the front desk; no company account needed.

golden_dataset.question: What expense code do I use for a software subscription under $50 a month?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: Use expense code EXP-114, which doesn't require manager pre-approval for subscriptions under $50/month.

golden_dataset.question: How quickly do I need to report a lost company device?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: Within 1 hour of discovery, to security@acme.example.

golden_dataset.question: How long is customer data retained after account closure?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: 7 years after account closure, then it is permanently deleted.

golden_dataset.question: How much parental leave do primary caregivers get?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: 16 weeks fully paid for the primary caregiver, 6 weeks for the secondary caregiver.

golden_dataset.question: What's the referral bonus for a senior engineering hire?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: $4,000, paid out after the new hire completes 90 days.

golden_dataset.question: How often can I get my company laptop replaced?
golden_dataset.ground_truth: Every 3 years, or sooner if it fails and IT can't repair it within 5 business days.
